from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityCDS(BaseModel):
    """One university's CDS data: housing percentage for freshmen and faculty count."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="The name of the university")
    housing_percentage: str = Field(description="Percentage of first-time freshmen in college-affiliated housing as reported in Section F1")
    faculty_count: int = Field(description="Total number of full-time instructional faculty as reported in Section I-1")
    section_f1_reference: str = Field(description="Section F1 reference text for verification")
    section_i1_reference: str = Field(description="Section I-1 reference text for verification")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'Fall 2021') if specified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityCDS]
